summary.headline: Moon–Mars Separation in Four Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the Moon’s separation from conjunction or opposition with Mars in Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, interpreted through conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition in terms of war, bloodshed, winds, heat, roads, soldiers, cities, and public affairs.
